paragraphs.text: That is, three angels in the shape of men.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Speaking to the one who appeared to be most majestic, for he thought they were men.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: For men used to go bare footed in those parts because of the heat.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: As sent by God that I should do my duty to you.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: For as God gave them bodies for a time, so he gave them the abilities of them, to walk, to eat and drink, and such like.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, about this time when she shall be alive, or when the child shall come into this life.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: For she believed the order of nature, rather than believing the promise of God.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Jehovah the Hebrew word we call Lord, shows that this angel was Christ: for this word is only applied to God.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: He shows that fathers ought both to know God's judgments, and to declare them to their children.
paragraphs.label: i
paragraphs.anchor: that he will command his children

paragraphs.text: God speaks after the fashion of men: that is, I will enter into judgment with good advise.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: For our sins cry for vengeance, though no one accuses us.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: God declares that his judgments were done with great mercy, even though all were so corrupt that not only fifty but ten righteous men could not be found there, and also that the wicked are spared for the sake of the righteous.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: By this we learn, that the nearer we approach to God, the more our miserable estate appears, and the more we are humbled.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: If God did not refuse the prayer for the wicked Sodomites, even to the sixth request, how much more will he grant the prayers of the godly for the afflicted Church?
paragraphs.label: o
